definition.text: Sum of the squared error (SSE), also known as scatter, is a measure of clustering quality calculated by summing the squared Euclidean distances from each data point to its closest centroid.

scope.text: SSE is used to compare different K-means clustering results, where a smaller squared error indicates that centroids better represent the points in their cluster; lower SSE is associated with better clustering results.
